value.name: couple stands at altar
value.description: Miles and Marylin stand before the altar as the wedding ceremony continues.
evidence: Miles and Marylin stand before the alter.

value.name: Marylin accepts marriage vow
value.description: Marylin answers yes when Judge Munson asks whether she will take Miles as her lawful wedded husband.
evidence: Do you, Miles Herbert Massey of Massey Meyerson take Marylin Hamilton-Rexroth-Doyle?

value.name: Miles interrupts the vows
value.description: Miles blurts out his response before the judge finishes reciting the vows, prompting the judge to stop him.
evidence:
MILES
I do, yah I do, uh huh --

value.name: judge rebukes Miles
value.description: Judge Munson scolds Miles for interrupting and jokes that he seems to have been married before.
evidence:
JUDGE MUNSON
-- Jesus! Haven't you ever been
married before?

value.name: Miles submits to ceremony
value.description: Chastened by the judge, Miles bows his head and waits for the vows to continue.
evidence: There is a long beat, through which Miles stares at his shoes.

value.name: Miles completes vow
value.description: After a pause, Miles finally says he does and completes his part of the marriage vows.

value.name: Marylin completes vow
value.description: Judge Munson asks Marylin to take Miles as her husband, and she agrees.
evidence: And do you, Marylin Hamilton-Rexroth Doyle, take Miles Herbert Massey of Massey Meyerson, to be your lawful wedded husband, to have and to hold, to love and to cherish, till death do you part?

value.name: judge pronounces marriage
value.description: Judge Munson declares Miles and Marylin husband and wife.
evidence:
JUDGE MUNSON
I now pronounce you man and wife.

value.name: Wrigley cries
value.description: Wrigley bursts into tears at the wedding pronouncement.

value.name: married montage begins
value.description: The scene transitions into a montage of the newly married Masseys.
